items.question: Is this a full custom website?
items.answer: The €999 MVP package is a professionally designed, modern homepage built on a proven high-converting structure and tailored to your business, copy, and brand. It's intentionally scoped as an MVP so we can deliver it fast - additional pages or custom features can be scoped separately.

items.question: What is included in the €999?
items.answer: A redesigned, mobile-first homepage with conversion-focused copywriting, a working contact form, WhatsApp/phone click-to-call, a location/contact section, basic on-page SEO, and a private preview before anything goes live.

items.question: How fast can you launch?
items.answer: Once you approve the preview and provide any missing content, your MVP website is typically ready within 48 hours.

items.question: Do I need to provide content?
items.answer: No - we draft the copy based on your existing website and information you share. You can request edits before launch. If you have specific photos, logos, or text you'd like used, you can send those too.

items.question: Can I request changes?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes a preview stage where you can request changes before the final version is built and launched.

items.question: Is hosting included?
items.answer: The MVP package gets your site hosting-ready. Ongoing hosting, updates, and monitoring are available via our optional Care Plan (€99/month), or you can host it yourself.

items.question: Can you connect my domain?
items.answer: Yes - once your MVP is approved, we help connect it to your existing domain or a new one.

items.question: Do you work with my industry?
items.answer: WLABS uses configurable industry templates for dentists, physiotherapists, plumbers, electricians, lawyers, accountants, real estate agencies, restaurants/cafés, beauty/aesthetics clinics, and construction/trades businesses - and we can adapt to most local service businesses.

items.question: Do you build online shops?
items.answer: The MVP package is focused on lead-generation homepages for local businesses, not full e-commerce stores. If you need an online shop, get in touch and we can discuss scope separately.

items.question: Who owns the website?
items.answer: You do. Once launched, the website and its content belong to your business.
